nodes.label: ADR 0165: GLUE Home makes the duplicate groups and points playlists at the best copies
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home's Rust engine must replicate the duplicates work (matching, grouping, rewriting playlists to best copies) to keep the page a screen only; avoiding multiple tabs or devices independently making writes (ADR 0162). Groups and best-list rewrites are held byte-for-byte identical to JavaScript pure functions by golden tests.
